name: Ciena
fiscalYearEnd: Saturday nearest October 31 (FY2025 ended 2025-11-01; Q3 FY2026 ended 2026-08-01)
description: Ciena sells the optical transport gear that carries internet traffic between data centers and across telecom networks (coherent optical line systems and pluggable modems), plus routers and switches, network software and services. Customers are cloud providers (one was 18% of FY2025 revenue), telecom service providers (one was 11%) and other network operators; the five largest were about 50% of revenue. Hardware is sold per system, with software licences and a services layer (maintenance, deployment) on top. AI-driven data-center interconnect demand pushed revenue up 19% in FY2025 and 37% in Q3 FY2026.

sub.name: Data-center networking, servers, optics and cooling

businessLines.name: Networking Platforms (Optical Networking; Routing and Switching)
businessLines.how: One-time hardware sales (optical transport systems, coherent modems, routers) to cloud and telecom operators, tied to network build-outs.
businessLines.description: Optical Networking $3,246.2M (68.1% of revenue); Routing and Switching $430.1M (9.0%).

businessLines.name: Platform Software and Services
businessLines.how: Software licences and recurring subscription and support on the installed network.
businessLines.description: Software and subscription services attached to the platforms.

businessLines.name: Blue Planet Automation Software and Services
businessLines.how: Software licences, subscriptions and associated professional services.

businessLines.name: Global Services
businessLines.how: Annual maintenance contracts plus fees for deployment and installation projects.
businessLines.description: Maintenance, Support and Learning $317.2M; Implementation $246.0M; Advisory and Enablement $50.5M.
